name: Bookmarks (reference plugin)
description: The canonical Bakin plugin template: a small bookmarks manager exercising routes, exec tools, settings, search, health checks, SSE events, and storage — written only against @makinbakin/sdk.

apiRoutes.description: Saves a bookmark, indexes it for search, and emits reference-bookmarks.changed.
Removes the bookmark and its search document.
Auto-registered by the search content type; declared here because user-plugin routes must be mirrored in the manifest.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_reference-bookmarks_save
execTools.description: Lets agents save a bookmark with tags and an optional note. Same code path as the POST route.
